items.title: Music Is Invisible (Pentimento Volume Three)
items.note: Out October 2 on Ndeya. Music from his Pentimento Trilogy. Worth a listen for that fourth-world trumpet haze.

items.title: Radical Frame
items.note: Musique concrete mixed with club-ready production. A strange, dense record.

items.title: Phren
items.note: A collaboration between a producer and a guitarist. Listed as ambient and experimental.

items.title: Waters Dance
items.note: Listed as jazz on Bandcamp. I found little else, so this one is a hunch.

items.title: Cyano
items.note: Out on RVNG Intl. Ambient, experimental electronic, from a reliably calm writer.

items.title: LUMINA
items.note: The Italian duo moves electronics to the centre, with synths and club rhythms beside oud, cello and vibraphone.

items.title: AT/DC
items.note: Warm guitar and banjo with reverb and synth. Described as close to Rain Drinkers.

items.title: RUIN: It's Not Just Music
items.note: Ambient, experimental electronic. I could not find more detail than that.

items.title: Friction
items.note: Out on Dragon's Eye Recordings. Field recordings with wordless vocals and a sense of endless space.

items.title: Baby Ghost
items.note: Falsetto voice mixed with bowed double bass, which gives it an otherworldly feel.
